CHIEF COMPLAINT
Follow-up visit status post mitral valve repair.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Patient is a 63-year-old female presenting for follow-up evaluation following mitral valve repair performed on 8/3/2020. She reports feeling significantly better since surgery. She continues to experience occasional chest discomfort and shallow breathing with exertion, occurring a couple of times per month, lasting only a few minutes and resolving with rest. Episodes recur after a couple of weeks of being symptom-free. Patient has learned to recognize her limitations and slows down when symptoms occur, typically able to resume activities afterward. Previous follow-up on 9/17 showed patient doing well from cardiac standpoint. ECG from 12/26/2020 shows atrial fibrillation with controlled ventricular response and anteriorly-directed T-wave inversions, unchanged from prior study.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Patient denies new symptoms. Reports continued intermittent chest discomfort and dyspnea with exertion. Denies other systemic complaints.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
- Mitral regurgitation
- Atrial fibrillation
- Diabetes mellitus
- Asthma
- Recurrent chest discomfort with negative cardiac workup for coronary artery disease
- Status post mitral valve repair (8/3/2020)

MEDICATIONS
- Coumadin 4 mg daily
- Lasix 4 mg daily
- Atenolol 50 mg daily

ALLERGIES
Not documented.

FAMILY HISTORY
Not documented.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Not documented.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
General: Patient appearing well.
Head/Neck: No jugular venous distention detected.
Lungs: Reduced breath sounds but clear to auscultation and percussion bilaterally.
Heart: Irregularly irregular rhythm consistent with atrial fibrillation. S1 slightly accentuated, no S3 gallop appreciated.
Abdomen: Soft, non-tender.
Extremities: Trace peripheral edema noted. Feet non-tender.

RESULTS
ECG (12/26/2020): Atrial fibrillation with controlled ventricular response, anteriorly-directed T-wave inversions, no significant changes compared to prior study.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
63-year-old female with history of mitral regurgitation and atrial fibrillation, status post successful mitral valve repair in August 2020. Currently recovering well from surgery. Atrial fibrillation is well-controlled on current medical regimen. Occasional exertional chest discomfort and dyspnea are manageable with activity modification. Continue current medications: Coumadin 4 mg daily, Lasix 4 mg daily, and Atenolol 50 mg daily. Encourage continued physical activity as tolerated. Follow-up appointment in 6-9 months.
